kultivator.kota42.hewan.kucing.elus: You stroke %s; it purrs and butts its head into your palm.
kultivator.kota42.hewan.kucing.ikut: %s wolfs down your fish, then trots after you with its tail held high.
kultivator.kota42.hewan.kucing.kenyang: %s is already full; it just rubs itself against your legs.
kultivator.kota42.hewan.lao_hua.elus: Lao Hua, the old orange cat, shuts his eyes and purrs like a little stove.
kultivator.kota42.hewan.lao_hua.ikut: Lao Hua finishes your fish, licks his whiskers and walks beside you as if you were his new servant. The market sellers laugh: "Lao Hua only follows good people."
kultivator.kota42.hewan.anjing.elus: Its tail wags hard; it lolls its tongue and pushes its muzzle into your hand.
kultivator.kota42.hewan.anjing.elus_penj: The big guard dog accepts your hand calmly, its thick coat warm under your fingers.
kultivator.kota42.hewan.anjing.tuan: %s barks happily at its master and trots in a circle round you.
kultivator.kota42.hewan.anjing.ikut: You have no house or shop here, so %s just gnaws the bone and follows you for a while.
kultivator.kota42.hewan.anjing.sudah: %s already guards your place in this town; this dog only wags its tail and gnaws the bone.
kultivator.kota42.hewan.anjing.jaga_ruma: %s gnaws the bone, then walks to the door of your house in %s and lies down there. From now on it guards your house.
kultivator.kota42.hewan.anjing.jaga_toko: %s gnaws the bone, then sits down in front of your shop in %s. Night thieves will think twice.
kultivator.kota42.hewan.ayam.biji: The chicken pecks the seeds at your feet and starts trailing after you.
kultivator.kota42.hewan.ayam.elus: The chicken wants no petting: it squawks, flaps and runs.
kultivator.kota42.hewan.ayam.tangkap: You catch the chicken; feathers fly, and it goes back to its pen.
kultivator.kota42.hewan.kuda.elus: The horse snorts softly and nudges your shoulder.
kultivator.kota42.hewan.kuda.elus_hias: The wedding horse nods; the red ribbons in its mane sway.
kultivator.kota42.hewan.kuda.makan: The horse eats the treat from your palm.
kultivator.kota42.hewan.unta.elus: The camel sniffs your face, then snorts haughtily.
kultivator.kota42.hewan.unta.makan: The camel chews your gift slowly, its jaw sliding left and right.
kultivator.kota42.hewan.keledai.elus: The donkey flicks its long ears and snorts.
kultivator.kota42.hewan.keledai.elus_gil: The mill donkey stops a moment, looks at you, then goes back round the millstone.
kultivator.kota42.hewan.keledai.makan: The donkey munches your gift contentedly.
kultivator.kota42.hewan.uji.mati: Town animals are switched off in the config (kotaHewan.aktif).
kultivator.kota42.hewan.uji.baris: %s animals line up in front of you for 30 seconds, 3 seconds per state (%s).
kultivator.kota42.hewan.uji.daftar: Town animals: %s active places, %s live animals (world cap %s). Rows: site, kind, live/candidates, per kind.
